title: Kooky Gooey Canadian Tamarind Ball Pasta
description: A rich and indulgent Canadian dish featuring tamarind balls, score-fat, and a hint of mustard, this recipe is perfect for a special occasion. It is also FODMAP-friendly, making it accessible to those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the score-fat over medium heat until melted.
Add the tamarind balls to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
Add the mustard, garlic-infused oil, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to coat with the sauce.
Transfer the pasta to a serving dish and top with grated cheddar cheese.
Place the dish under the broiler and cook until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and serve immediately.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
